pages.text: Gear to your ceiling before you knock — Cataclysm's massive T3–T4 dungeon structures hold the pack's ultra-boss encounters and their unique materials.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Cataclysm is the hardest T3 content. Five ultra-bosses (Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis, The Harbinger, The Leviathan, Maledictus) each in enormous purpose-built structures.$(br2)$(bold)Loot:$() Cataclysm structures have some of the highest token drop rates in T3. Boss materials from Cataclysm bosses are among the best T3 crafting components.

$(bold)Prep requirement:$() Full terrasteel or enderium gear is the minimum recommended for Cataclysm boss attempts. Maledictus and The Harbinger in particular are calibrated for well-geared T3 players.$(br2)$(bold)Unique weapons:$() 8 Simply Swords uniques drop from Cataclysm bosses — the most of any single mod.

$(bold)No guide book.$() Cataclysm is boss-focused — documentation comes from fighting. Each boss drops a $(bold)Trophy$() that can be placed for display. JEI covers all weapon and armor recipes unlocked by boss materials.$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Netherite Monstrosity — the entry ultra-boss: $(l:icraft:bosses/t3_bosses)Tier 3 Bosses$(/l).$()
